correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 30–83. Multiplying Fourier columns by z_j² gives an invertible Vandermonde; conjugation makes the unique weights real. Taking the constant term of the Laurent cardinal function and pairing the six e₂ terms gives F/(8P), with two negative and two positive factors in P. On the box of radius at most 1/4 the ∆ bound fixes first the u₁ and u₃ extrema, then the narrowed ∆ bound and 2 sin²(π/5)>sin(π/5) fix u₀ and u₄ strictly. The minimized numerator decreases from positive at zero to 1−√5/2<0 at 1/4. The exact threshold and the four saturated displacements follow, with cyclic symmetry and nesting handling the other nodes and larger boxes up to 1/2. An independent real moment-system replay (`python3 /workspace/independent_replay.py numeric`) gives positive, zero to numerical precision, and negative central weights at 0.2, the boundary, and 0.22. The exact constant is correct; the decimal in the Finding has a one-unit last-place discrepancy, with true value 0.20145942246051052177…. The bounded numerical replay does not prove the analytic box assertion.
